_how: Copy to deck/a2_text.json after the results are in. Every key is optional; a missing key falls back to the text the builder derives from the data. '**Lead** rest' renders Lead in bold.
prediction_misses: **<claim>:** predicted <x>, measured <y> — because <reason, with the number from the log/.jtl that shows it>.
recommendation_extra: **Defence:** <one line answering the obvious objection, e.g. why a 5 % gain inside run-to-run spread is or is not worth deploying>.
